body:
Complete route-by-route adoption of the shared OPF workflow without changing each site's look and feel. Essential work stays offline; preserve source formatting, validation, undo/redo and last-valid preview. Package adoption is separate from feature acceptance.

Updated 21 September 2026 after canonical production checks. The published train remains core **0.11.0**, CLI/renderer **0.9.0**, PPTX **0.9.1** and editor **0.8.0**, on Node 24. **Keep this issue open**: App47 is deployed at `0f35352a1445f56ad4bb7c9f4c5609e01f2dd9ae`, with green Linux/Windows pre/post-merge CI and canonical READY deployment `dpl_5zdunyqiun7MgJNRJZ33CMHTrmmN`. The fresh canonical browser run is **23/24**, zero retries: all five new completion cases pass; the existing LF Author third popup fails. Earlier app45 14/18 and app46 11/19 failures remain retained. A read-only deployment check on 21 September confirmed this is still production.

- [x] Verify openpresentation.org `/` and `/playground` baseline: thirteen workflows covering edit directions, source formatting, contextual options, undo/redo, metadata, offline and mobile recovery.
- [x] Verify gallery layout-card/detail Playground and Editor links and config handoff. Gallery35/36 are merged and canonical docs-to-editor checks pass at `f17e9ae5869669d5fbac3720f285652d0c37551c`.
- [x] Replace stale current public guidance. Core93/97/98 are merged; quickstart/matrix/current API guides describe the published train. Site43/44 are merged and canonical `a85bcc77d899ce9ba1df659548be564142c16120` passes 321 checks across 11 pages and 18 raw resources, plus actual agent clipboard/skill bytes and OPF/SVG/PPTX downloads. The full guide includes complete Markdown guides with evidence links and preserves raw resource bytes. Historical evidence and immutable CLI bundled skills remain explicitly scoped.
- [x] Implement all-slide Inspector editing, minimal JSON source changes with exact undo/redo, stale-draft cancellation, render recovery and accessible font notes. [App45](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/pull/45) merged as `e37e0da19671178da482bbe52cfd642419b670b5`; Linux and Windows pre/post-merge CI passed. Canonical READY deployment: `dpl_BcdbKFRoReTjKbQnMQ2e4NZSVask`.
- [x] Deploy the focused explicit-paste correction. [App46](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/pull/46) merged as `c558dcc3a2e362bc238eb433a2db97fa682dfcc8` with the identical reviewed tree, green Linux/Windows pre/post-merge CI and canonical READY deployment `dpl_AGzL3mmPqZ5giiQWzh9EqyDPF8SX`. The old-build regression reproduces a 302→443 byte rewrite; the fixed local build preserves all 302 and explicit Format Document/undo. Local622 unit/19 browser checks pass. No package version changed.
- [ ] Complete canonical app readiness and preservation acceptance. App47 is **23/24**, not accepted overall. Its five new completion checks pass, but one existing categorical scenario still fails. Prior app45/app46 readiness, worker and source-preservation outcomes remain historical evidence; a later pass does not establish the cause of each earlier failure. Do not substitute local/CI success for canonical checks or blindly raise timeouts.
- [ ] Resolve Author categorical reliability. A separate diagnostic reproduces the missing third LF popup and observes actual editor focus, supported Suggest action, and a stale `inQuickInput`/quick-pick context simultaneously. The OPF provider is not invoked by that physical key. Installed Monaco source gives the hidden Quick Input Ctrl+Space binding higher priority; the internal chosen-command name is inferred from these observed conditions, not instrumented. A reviewed public-action guard is under local verification and is **not deployed**. Earlier Loading-popup observations remain separately scoped.
- [x] Correct the Monaco completion-range adapter defect. [App47](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/pull/47) maps scalar and disjoint additional edits, retains authored whitespace, omits unchanged values, and invalidates stale catalogs/source. Installed Monaco validates 1,829 alternatives across 59 positions, and all five new canonical completion checks pass with exact source/undo behavior. This correction did not resolve the separate missing popup.
- [ ] Resolve or explicitly scope broader raw-source boundaries. [App53](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/pull/53) is a held draft at reviewed head `8c0dae19b339ef3fe6a06c1d2df9f96b31d4f575`: Author canvas/Copy/export and Inspector JSON downloads retain source through the existing bridge; an order-only reimport-history defect is corrected. Final local browser acceptance is **26/27**, with the categorical popup still failing. CI at that head passed Linux but failed Windows **26/27** on Inspector shared-load readiness; the security assertions were not reached. Neither result is acceptance. Subsequent keyboard work is uncommitted and has no fresh CI yet. Other local metadata/filename/gallery/preset writers and raw imported-file bytes remain separately scoped; a source audit also flags preset Undo all restoring a stale whole-document snapshot after intervening edits.

Original audit and preserved observations: [PR93 evidence](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf/blob/937047ff9f65d936126c577d3c6b7c5f9a61e364/docs/evidence/shipped-train-20260921/production/REPORT.md). [Current main handoff](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf/blob/c3e35b92e53d12764f9b1b7487ccfb7325d5c1aa/docs/handoff-2026-09-21.md) and its linked evidence retain merged-source, platform CI, deployment, failed-run and follow-up receipts. [App53 source evidence](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/tree/8c0dae19b339ef3fe6a06c1d2df9f96b31d4f575/docs/evidence/author-source-preservation-20260921) is draft-only. Do not treat source merge, npm publication, browser checks or native application acceptance as interchangeable.

Out of scope here: native Office/p:hf [#87](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf/issues/87), renderer [issue24](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf-render/issues/24) at the unchanged **0.1px** gate, and the coordinated geometry drafts (core94/render27/editor25/PPTX42/site40). Do not merge site40 alone. The broader developer-ready goal remains open.
